title: Design Studio theme and legacy package
description: Format 2 stores visual tokens, brand and constrained appearance overrides. The shared component library owns structure, native implementation, previews, padding and gaps. Format 1 remains readable without implicit migration. Runtime resolves aliases and requires positive shared semantic spacing.

styles.description: CamelCase CSS properties from the engine allowlist. References use {token.id}. Runtime validates properties and resolved values.

oneOf.description: Escaped declarative catalog preview. Part and variant references must exist. Runtime limits total nodes to 200 and depth to 12.

brand.description: Optional brand guidance. Runtime checks cross-references, unique local IDs and case-insensitive filenames, canonical base64, passive SVG, matching file extensions/content, increasing font weight ranges and maximum decoded asset sizes of 256 KiB each and 512 KiB combined. Font assets become self-contained @font-face rules in generated CSS.

appearanceStyles.description: Only visual appearance properties. Layout, padding, gaps, selectors, markup and semantic structure are owned by the shared library.
